units.source_text: [\[26\]](#part1333.html#w26) 王朝时代殿内主屋中设有比地面略高之寝台，四周垂挂帐幕，为贵人坐卧之用。

en.t: [26] In the main rooms of palace residences during the courtly age, there were sleeping platforms set slightly higher than the floor, with curtains hung around them on all sides, used by nobles for sitting or reclining.
